facts.claim: In a solar eclipse the Moon blocks the Sun's light and casts its shadow on Earth.

source.title: NASA Space Place: Lunar Eclipses and Solar Eclipses
source.quote: An eclipse happens when a planet or a moon gets in the way of the Sun’s light. … solar eclipse happens when the Moon gets in the way of the Sun’s light and casts its shadow on Earth.

facts.source_sentence: An eclipse happens when a planet or a moon gets in the way of the Sun’s light. … solar eclipse happens when the Moon gets in the way of the Sun’s light and casts its shadow on Earth.

facts.claim: In a lunar eclipse Earth blocks the sunlight reaching the Moon, and the Moon gets darker.

source.title: NASA Space Place: Lunar Eclipses and Solar Eclipses
source.quote: During a lunar eclipse, Earth gets in the way of the Sun’s light hitting the Moon. … In a lunar eclipse, the Moon gets darker.

facts.source_sentence: During a lunar eclipse, Earth gets in the way of the Sun’s light hitting the Moon. … In a lunar eclipse, the Moon gets darker.
